Class NetworkSetupController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.controllers.BaseTUIController
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.controllers.NetworkSetupController
All Implemented Interfaces:
UpdateHandler, MessageVisitor
public class NetworkSetupController extends BaseTUIController
First TUI screen: it asks the user for the connection settings (RMI or socket, server IP and port), opens the connection through the factory and wraps it in a ConnectionManager for automatic reconnection, then registers it on the context. On success it advances to the pre-lobby screen; on failure it reports the error and retries from the start.
